scope: Source-only retention audit plus existing 120-second profile summary metadata; no workload/profile/test or large receipt parse for this audit

explicit_estimates.method: Linear scale of (120-second sampled measurement peak minus startup-and-seed sampled peak) per successful logical operation, then add the same startup peak. Receipt-byte estimate scales the actual file size per successful operation. These are illustrative estimates, not limits or measured long peaks. Fixed-time resource samples, startup overhead, heap behavior and serialization are not independently decomposed.

unavailable: Whole target-process lifetime high-water RSS across final JSON serialization
Parent peak RSS while loading complete application receipt
Target Python GC collection or pause timeline
A guaranteed process/host memory upper bound from these short observations

retention.page_value: 100 independently parsed title strings retained by each normalized page value, plus a title list and version list of 100 references each; full page DTO dictionaries and HTTP response body are not deliberately retained after the operation task ends.
retention.cycle_value: Scalar normalized cycle outcome; separate mutation ledger retains IDs, request key/hash/scope/status and encoded first response bytes for the independent durable oracle.
retention.application_samples: 50 ms procfs dictionaries appended for the full application lifetime; O(duration), even though the published receipt refers to the already-written JSONL file.
retention.perf_target: Own generator resource rows are written immediately, not appended to an in-memory list. Extra metadata has fixed-size phase/counter/identity structures and configured recovery records; inherited B23 operations/mutations/sample lists remain.
retention.durable_oracle: All rows plus an expected-key dictionary; PostgreSQL observer also materializes captured CSV text and tuple rows. These transient graphs coexist with retained operations and mutations.
retention.receipt_writer: common.save uses json.dumps(indent=2, sort_keys=True) before atomic write; pinned CPython JSONEncoder.encode materializes list(iterencode(...)) then joins a complete string.
retention.parent_reader: execute_cell fully json.loads the complete application receipt although its consumers need only status, durable_oracle and closed.

limitations: All calculations concern measurement harness processes, not product RSS or a Rust-vs-C# performance difference.
Finite request count bounds the eventual graph size but does not make it constant-memory or guarantee the available host budget.
The planned 500/s accounting cap alone is not a memory safety bound. Long-run validity and generator interference still require actual measurement.
No driver/runtime changes were made. All existing calibration inputs remain untouched.
